title: The Most Secret Teaching
translation: Thus I have told you this most secret teaching, O sinless one. Understanding it, one becomes wise and has done all that is to be done, O Bharata.
translation_hi: हे निष्पाप, इस प्रकार मैंने यह अत्यंत गुप्त शास्त्र तुम्हें बताया। हे भारत, इसे समझकर मनुष्य बुद्धिमान और कृतकृत्य हो जाता है।

words.meaning: one who has done all that is to be done
